Strategy: Keep the winning [28,42] bonus and add a penalty just above the band, [43,55], to stop choices drifting into slightly roomier leftovers.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if 28 <= r - item <= 42 else 0) - (15 if 43 <= r - item <= 55 else 0) for r in bins]
```
